nom: TATCHA The Longevity Memory Cream Moisturizer

avis.texte: I do love this product; but the clean claims are just not true. This cream contains phenoxyethanol, an anti-microbial preservative that can badly irritate eyes, cause endocrine disruption, affect liver, blood and fertility, is banned over 1% in EU. It's also highly polluting to manufacture. Gonna have to try something else.
I really like this product. It goes on nice and cool and it does plump up the skin, It does have slightly sticky feel though, it doesn't bother me, but to some it might

avis.titre: Don't Forget the Sunscreen with this one!
avis.texte: I bounce between the dewy and the water cream for moisturizers from Tatcha. I thought this would be a good go between. It really is, and honeslty I like it more. The texture is different. It's like a thicker, bouncier water cream. A little goes a LONG way. It gives me a nice dewy glow that stays all day but doesnt cause more oil on my forehead. It makes my pores a little less visible and definitely smoothes out my lines. I will say, don't skip your SPF with this one!! Ten minutes in the sun and my face is burnt red whereas usually I can be out for an hour or so before turning pink. lol So definitely remember your SPF when using this one. My skincare regiment is Banilla cleansing balm, Tatcha Rice Wash, Peach and Lily Glass Skin Polisher, Anua Heatleaf 77 toner, Peach and Lily Glass Skin serum, whatever eyecream I have a sample of and then Tatcha moistuizers.
Great cream and serum! But unfortunately I can't use it due niacinamide. It's a huge no no for my skin. I had to learn the hard way
OK, the texture does take a while to get used to. Felt weird at first. I was using too much, but after a few days I think I've got it. You only need a little, and it does blend and spread nicely

Love the Longevity cream! I have really been able to see a difference in my skin, use it every night. It has a bouncy feel to it, very unique. Maybe an eye cream to use with the Longevity serum and cream would make a nice three sum?
Good but much thicker than I'm used to. Hoping to see long term difference.
I love the way it feels and my skin absorbs it well. My skin feels fuller and smoother
Not good. Terrible texture and impossible to even get out of the jar

avis.titre: Feel the difference after first application!
avis.texte: I'm a 55 yo woman who has been faithfully using Tatcha's dewy plumping cream, but I decided to try out my free sample of the longevity cream before heading out to meet a friend for lunch. I sat down and she immediately noticed something about my face. She said, "You have no wrinkles!" Now, let me explain, I was wearing a hat, so my forehead wrinkles were covered, but the firmness I felt after I applied that cream was noticeable to others 30 minutes later. I didn't get rid of my plumping cream, I use that at night, but the longevity cream is my new day cream along with the serum! I won't do Botox, but I will do Tatcha longevity cream!
This cream makes my skin feel smooth and helps minimize my wrinkles

I like the formula except for the absorption. I have a difficult time massaging it into my skin. However, I have reactive skin and this didn't cause any reactions. My skin looks good after application. I haven't used it regularly enough to speak on the other proposed benefits.
I was hoping that it would do more for my aging skin. It seems to be make my skin dry. I was e pe ting more radiance and glow.
Seems okay so far. If you put too much on, it cracks and you have to scrape it off.
Either the serum or the cream is making my face itch all day. Usually I don't get irritation from tatcha.

I appreciate your brand and the quality of your products. I recently tried one of your new items, and while I know it's a great product, unfortunately, it didn't work well for my face. I just wanted to share that feedback, but I still love your brand overall.

I love the Longevity cream. A little goes a long way. I love the bounce of the cream and the way it smooths nicely on your face. I've only been using it for a little over a week, but I love this cream a loy
The cool gel consistency was not as moisturizing as I was expecting. I use the dewey mosturizer and find it more to my likeing. I live in a very dry climate.

At first I wasn't sure about the texture and was probably using too much because it springs back in the container. After about a month of use, I love it, and my Botox injector even complimented my skin and asked what I was doing different! My only not-quite-complaint is that I wish the subscription/refill option were available for this product, and I hope it will be soon

gifted by tatcha, I've been reaching for the Tatcha Longevity Memory Cream whenever my skin feels dull, tired, or out of balance, and it never disappoints. The formula has this velvety, almost whipped texture that instantly comforts the skin while sinking in beautifully—no heaviness, no residue, just a smooth, hydrated finish. What I love most is how restorative it feels. My skin looks fuller, calmer, and more even-toned, especially after long days, stress, or travel. It gives that "well-rested skin" effect where everything just looks healthier and more refined. I also appreciate how well it plays with the rest of my routine—it layers effortlessly and makes my skin feel primed and resilient.

I tested this out through a sample and I did not like it. The texture of this cream is weird, almost like jelly. Even after putting it on my skin, it felt strange. I gave the remainder of my sample to my mother, who also didn't like it. I'm just gonna stick to the dewy cream and the indigo overnight cream, which are both much nicer
It feels nice, but this is not something I like under makeup it made my makeup pill which it never does. So this is better suited for PM use imo.
It's thick when I dab on my face. It's not creamy like the Water Cream. It does feel a little heavy when I rub into my face but not much. But I can feel the difference between the two.

avis.titre: It has completely changed my skin
avis.texte: This moisturizer is fantastic. I use the essence and Longevity serum beforehand, then finish with the moisturizer and it has transformed my skin. I break out easily with some products and haven't at all with this. It's so gentle but extremely effective. The consistently is unusual, but once massaged in feels great. My skin is smooth and glowing - strangers have complimented my skin. I'm always happy to confidently share the Tatcha products that I use - they're fantastic.
I use other Tatcha products and moisturizers, but this new moisturizer is a cut above the rest. The texture and fragrance (very light) are so beautiful. I think I have found my forever moisturizer!

I've now had time to try this several times, and unfortunately it just hasn't worked for me the way I hoped it would. The biggest thing that stands out is how it seems to sit on top of my skin rather than actually absorbing into it. No matter how little I use or how much I work it in, it feels like it just creates a layer instead of sinking in and truly moisturizing. Because of that, my skin never really feels hydrated — it just feels coated. I kept waiting for that soft, nourished, "plump" feeling you expect from a cream like this, but it never quite happens for me. It's especially disappointing considering this item is not cheap. At this price point, I really expect a formula that absorbs beautifully and delivers noticeable moisture, and sadly this one just didn't live up to that expectation for me.
I absolutely Love the new Longevity cream and Serum. It brightens and smoothies skin providing great texture leaving the skin flowing and feeling firmer. I love this product it's worth the cost.
This moisturizer is absolutely amazing! I think I've finally found "The One!" I have extremely dry, mature skin and it feels and looks great now!
Think it will okay for summer use, my skin is very dry and aging so the Dewey is best for me especially with the cold weather. But think it may be good for use in the summer months.

This product is not like the other. Its sticky in the face upon application. I prefer the water based effect. So far, i haven't seen the youthful look effect it is promising on its slogan. But would still used its empty:grin:
Right after starting this, I started getting compliments that my skin was glowing. The formula is definitely different from other moisturizers, but it feels refreshing and leaves the skin beautiful.

This product has an astringent acting agent to it. After it dries(and it's a bit sticky) it seems to dry out my skin, finding that I need to apply more. It might be better suited for much younger skin. That clearly wasn't in the description. Should have stuck with the Dewy skin cream.

Unfortunately, after using it this week, both my husband and I experienced breakouts. This was really disappointing, especially since our skin had been doing so well after consistently using your Dewy Skin Cream, Water Cream, Brightening Serum, and Eye Cream for nearly two years. This is the only new product we've introduced, and it clearly did not agree with our skin. We also hated the texture; had to return it.

avis.titre: Wonderful and luxurious moisturizer for winter
avis.texte: I needed something more substantial for a very cold winter and running outside in the elements. I don't like heavy moisturizers and this is the best combination of deep moisture yet pillowy soft. Absolutely no oily or heavy feel at all. A little goes a long way also. Luxurious and effective. Excellent new addition to the line.

So far, I'm really enjoying this product. I love the texture, and the formula itself feels excellent on my skin. The only downside for me has been the packaging. I've had difficulty with securing the lid, and the inner tub frequently comes loose from the outer component. I own several other Tatcha products and haven't experienced packaging issues with those. That said, overall I'm very pleased with the product and the formula itself.

I really wanted to like this but the texture is so odd to me. It's a clumpy, jelly like feeling and hard to blend. Sometimes I get chunks of it on my face. I think this texture is trending right now but it's not for me. I will stick to the regular moisturizers.

Texture is not what I expected . A little tacky feeling after applying Ive only used for a week . My skin feels a bit firmer . I prefer the dewy skin cream leaves my skin feeling softer former and leaves a nice glow without tacky residue feeling

When my Longevity Cream arrived in the mail, my beloved dog had died and I had been ugly-face crying for 3 days. Nothing was making my undereyes look better until I tried the Longevity. The skin plumped back up in a way I didn't think my 55yr old eye skin could. I was able to go out and not look horrible. Thank you for the little moments of self-care you provide us!
At first a very strange consistency but it's nice once you get used to it. Great for the little spoon and easy to get the right amount of I love the scent and it's very hydrating.
It's been about two weeks and I can see and feel the difference in my skin.
Not good not hydrating I do not know what it's used for unless you want dry skin

I love all of Tatcha products but this one has a very unfamiliar texture and seems to be drying for my skin. I don't think I will reorder this again or recommend to others in my age. The Dewey cream is much better and I will wait until funds allow for me to substitute back to my go to cream. In the interim, I gifted both serum and cream to my neighbor with different skin type in hopes they will fall in love with Tatcha… staying pessimistic and optimistic in same breath.

Won't buy again. After loving the purple matcha face cream I thought I'd try this one and I'm really disappointed. It's not nearly as moisturizing leaving my winter face thirsty. I've been using it for ten days and am wholly unimpressed and will not repurchase.
I am so happy with the product, so hydrating and plumping!!! Will for sure buy again! Love!
I've used and loved Tatcha products for years but am disappointed with the Longevity Cream.
Love my Tatcha products;) The packaging is so beautiful,The longevity cream is amazing. I highly recommend this product
I decided to try the longevity cream instead of reordering Dewy skin. I absolutely love it! My skin is moisturized and glowing.
Have been using at night with Longevity serum for a few weeks now. Skin feels smoother and fresher. Love it!
Made my skin red , irritated, ichy, skin was burning for a week, very bad product, not recommended at all
Im really liking this formula. Goes on smooth, hydrates my skin. Not greasy or oily, soaks in nicely
Tatcha products are by far the best skin care products! My skin looks better than ever. These products have made such a difference in my skin I'll use only Tatch for my skin care routine.
I had high hopes for this moisturizer but it is disappointing. My skin is normal, and this moisturizer is drying. The slight fragrance is pleasant.

I got a sample of this and had to order the full size. I LOVE this moisturizer. Like most of Tatcha's products, it leaves my face feeling supple, nourished and the glow, y'all. It's perfection. I know people aren't fond of fragrance, but if your skin can tolerate it, go for it. I feel like the fragrance is part of the luxury of it all. Also, this product defines "a little goes a long way". I was disappointed in how much product was in there, but I've been using it for a month and it's hardly made a dent.
I don't think it works like advertised and not worth the high price

My entire skincare routine is comprised of Tatcha products but this is the one I am most impressed by! I use it in the morning under my makeup and it give my skin the perfect glowy look without being shiny or oily looking. My skin has never looked better :)
I don't know I like my creams to absorb it in my skin, but this one is just too greasy for me?
This is my first time trying the product and I love it!! I smell the feeling it's like you are at the spa!
I've tried all of Tacha's moisturizers and this is by far my favorite. Paired with the longer its serum my skin looks great at 59. Just purchased a second jar.
This is a definite winner. Cannot believe how soft my skin feels after using it!
Very unique texture and feel when you first touch in the container but it melts beautifully onto the skin after you apply it.
This is a must have product! Immediately cools the face & feels luxurious! Great to apply before makeup.
It dries quickly into my skin but then it feels like my skin needs more moisture. Should I be using a different product?
Do not like the odor or slimy texture. All other tatcha products are great. Will return to my previous Tatcha routine/skin care products.

This moisturizer is fantastic! I've recently had to revamp my entire skincare regimen due to perimenopause and going on HRT - my skin went from combo/oily to dry, tight, and starting to look aged. The Longevity Cream has really evened out the dryness and gotten rid of that tight feeling, leaving my skin feeling soft and smooth again, but without causing me to break out. I use it morning and night after cleansing. Highly recommended!

avis.titre: Not as good as I had hoped.
avis.texte: Not good for morning routine. Is kinda sticky. Cream is very thick and jelly-like. Night time application is ideal.

gifted by tatcha This cream is so thick but not greasy! It leaves my skin feeling so moisturized and rejuvenated. I can't wait to see what the long term results look like after using this cream. I'm definitely a fan and am going to continue to use!
Im so happy I decided to try this product. I just love it. I use it at night and my skin feels so soft and hydrated in the morning.

I love the scent and feel of this face cream. Was looking for something a little lighter than the Dewy Face Cream (which I still use at night). This is perfect. The scent is so beautiful that it feels like I'm having a spa like experience when applying it to my face.

Absolutely love and is so soft that I can't even describe the texture of it that is so soft. I've used most of the products so far now this one is my favorite but I do love the fact that you can intermix the serums and creams and everything on your face.
I love the cream it's bouncy and a little bit works really well

This cream is perfect for this winter season, since it is super hydrating! It absorbs into my skin quickly and leaves my skin looking brighter and more plump. The scent is subtle, but refreshing and the gold spoon included is perfect for application, so glad this was offered by Tatcha!

I purchased this cream 2 weeks ago and I am very impressed by the results. I have struggled to find something to help add moisture and keep my skin from flaking during my tretinoin use and have tried it all over the last year. This is the first product to really make a difference. I apply after my tretinoin at night and I am no longer experiencing the red, flaking patches!
Smoothes into skin beautifully, face stayed hydrated all day even in cold dry winter air!
I have been a longstanding Tatcha user. Not a fan of this product. Stays on the face and is tacky. I went back to the dewy skin version. Soaks in and feels much nicer to the touch.

avis.titre: Well, it fits for me. My face has been alive for almost 82 y
avis.texte: My skin, after a week felt and looked so much better. Less dry ness, softer glow, an all around fresher face.
I have not had it long enough to notice any changes to my skin. I do notice that the texture is different. It is more of a gel consistency versus a creamy one.
I like this product and the way it feels on my skin. Not greasy

gifted by tatcha in exchange for a review. i love the texture of this moisturizer. it's a blends out super smoothly but is also a bit gel like. the packaging is also super cute as expected from tatcha!

I've been using this cream for a week now and it has really helped with my dry flaky skin. I'm in love with the packaging especially the little spoon. I have sensitive skin and so far this cream has been great and hasn't irritated my skin. gifted by Tatcha

A true winter essential for dry skin. The decadent, creamy formula delivers lasting hydration and a subtle glow without any stickiness. My skin feels noticeably more elastic and nourished. gifted by tatcha

This product was gifted by tatcha. This has been great during the winter when my skin is on the dry side. My skin feels hydrated and plump since I started using. a great moisturizer I am excited to see long term results

I received this moisturizer complimentary from Tatcha. My review is honest and solely based on my experience using this product. This is actually my first full-size product I am trying from the brand. So far, I have only had samples of their products. I really like the nice packaging, it reminds me of an apple, the jar is lightweight and easy to travel with. Besides, the jar is refillable. The moisturizer itself has a nice herbal smell that does linger after application. The texture is bouncy, gel-like, and, in contact with the skin, it melts in right away. After applying it, my skin visibly gets glowy - that glistening skin effect, it feels hydrated and smooth. I have sensitive combination skin and this moisturizer is helping my skin survive this cold winter. I wish it wouldn't be so pricey, because I am starting to like it a lot.

I've been trying Tatcha's new Longevity Cream and its firm, gel texture deeply hydrates skin. It definitely plumps up my skin and makes it feel dewy and bouncy. The packaging is gorgeous and I love the little gold spoon. It has a citrusy, almost earthy smell that is fresh and energizing but not overpowering. The texture is on the heavier side, and it takes a while for it to absorb into my skin. I prefer using it at night. gifted by tatcha

I was gifted by tatcha but this will be a repurchase!! I have skin allergies and sensitivities so I typically use one moisturizer day and night. I wanted to try this because it's a barrier supportive with tons of other benefits and doesn't contain my allergens. I'm like two weeks in and my skin is so plump and glowy!! The cream itself is bouncy and jello like it's really innovative and soft to your face. I cannot believe how magical this is, having tried so many things to find what works with my allergies, I'm usually disappointed with new finds. Hence why I don't change my routine much/will spend the money on what works. The spoon it comes with is so darling to get the product out too omg. Love this so much

This cream quickly earned a spot in my daily routine. The memory-gel texture is light and springy, sinks in fast, and leaves the skin feeling softly padded and well-hydrated. After regular use, my complexion looks more luminous and elastic, with a rested, healthy glow. It delivers anti-aging results without any heaviness or shine, making it an easy, comfortable choice for every skin type and a great base for makeup. Gifted by tatcha

avis.titre: This Cream Feels Like a Spa in a Jar
avis.texte: I love this Tatcha cream—it makes me feel so bougie every time I use it. The packaging is super luxe, and the formula is deeply hydrating and incredibly soothing on my skin. It doesn't give much of a glow (which I personally love), but it leaves my skin feeling soft, calm, and pampered. Such a great option, especially for sensitive skin! -gifted by tatcha
Complimentary from Tatcha. I have to say this cream sits perfectly on the skin/face. It doesn't make your face feel heavy and filled with so much product. This cream is what I rave about.

I was gifted by tatcha and I couldn't be happier about this formula! I use this cream mostly at night before bed to give me that lifted and firm feeling. I love how moisturizing this formula is and it works with my skin very well. The scent is fresh and luxurious and the packaging is stunning.

I'm happy to say this Tatcha Longevity Cream is really good! My skin is combo and I sometimes breakout when trying new products but It's lightweight and has more of a gel texture but it reminds me of drink of water for my skin. gifted by tatcha

I have been giving this moisturizer a go for about three weeks. so far I have not seen any wrinkles go away but it has improved my skin. Every morning i wake up with a glowy skin which essentially makes my skin look more youthful. Even after i use makeup my skin looks plump. I look forward to continue using this and eventually seeing results. This was gifted by Tatcha.

avis.titre: Great for combo skin in the winter
avis.texte: This cream has a gel-like texture and resembles a mix of cream and serum. I have combination skin, so I'm always searching for a product that hydrates without making my skin too dry or too oily. This one strikes the perfect balance. My skin feels well-moisturized without any dry or oily spots. #gifted by tatcha

Gifted by Tatcha Lightweight but nourishing cream with a smooth, silky texture. It spreads easily and absorbs well without leaving any greasy feeling. I have combination skin, and it feels comfortable to wear both day and night. My skin feels soft and moisturized after use, and it works well under makeup. Overall, a simple and pleasant moisturizer that feels nice on the skin.

I'm not too sure about this yet as I need to give it some time. But I like this brand so far so I'm sure it won't disappoint. What I don't enjoy is the smell. But very moisturizing gifted by tatcha not too bad

This cream feels like an upgrade to my routine. It hydrates without being heavy and my skin looks smoother and a bit plumper, especially around my cheeks. I love the whole Okinawa inspiration it makes the product feel more thoughtful and nourishing. gifted by tatcha

This cream feels really rich and moisturizing without being heavy. My skin looks smoother and stays hydrated all day, and it works great under makeup. It's expensive, but it does leave my skin feeling more balanced and cared for. gifted by tatcha

Gave this to my mom to try out and she absolutely loved it! She said it left her skin feeling soft, supple, and moisturized. She uses it daily on her neck and face. After using it for two weeks, she says it's given her a gentle, youthful glow. #giftedbyTatcha

I didn't quite understand the "memory cream" concept until I tried this, but now I get the hype! The texture is incredible…a bouncy, memory foam-like gel cream that feels luxurious yet lightweight - and it's so satisfying to apply. It leaves that smooth, post-facial look and truly feels like an upgrade from a standard moisturizer. My skin looks noticeably brighter and more plump. It's definitely a splurge, but if you're looking for more hydrated, radiant, youthful looking skin that still feels light and breathable, this one is worth it. Gifted by Tatcha.

I was surprised at how much I liked this face cream. My face felt really smooth and soft. The texture is so unique and it's like nothing I've ever used before. I would definitely continue to use this. This product was gifted by tatcha.

I was gifted by Tatcha this moisturizer in exchange for my honest review. First I love the packaging! It is so sleek and special looking. I love the way my skin feels after using this moisturizer. It's a perfect addition to my skincare routine. It easily will be in my new routine.

Such a fancy cream! First of all the packaging it comes with is stunning and feels so luxe. The cream itself is a really lovely texture. It feels gentle and absorbs into skin leaving it feeling soft and hydrated. It also layers well with makeup which is great. Gifted by tatcha.

I really like the very unique cloud like texture. It melts onto your skin and leaves skin feeling hydrated and plump. For reference my skin is combination leaning dry and my main skincare to focus is on anti-aging ingredients. Gifted by Tatcha.

I've been looking for a cream that not only moisturizes my skin in the winter but also helps it stay hydrated and can help my skin look healthier and youthful, this does such a great job at all those plus gives my skin a beautiful glow. Overall my skin appears it's best. Gifted by Tatcha.

Love this new moisturizing cream from Tatcha! I have oily combination skin and this works for me - not too heavy/greasy and left me hydrated all day. This product was gifted by Tatcha in exchange for my honest review.

This is such a good cream for my combo dry skin. It is hydrating but at the same time doesn't make my skin very greasy or oily. It doesn't pill when I apply a foundation on top of it. It's a great one. Gifted by Tatcha

This is so different than other Tatcha moisturizers I've tried! First of all, the texture is quite firm (almost like jello initially) but when you scoop some up it melts so nicely into the skin. Very hydrating and nourishing, my skin drinks this up! I would say it's a medium weight moisturizer but it's really helping my dry skin. This was gifted by Tatcha for my honest review.

Really easy to use and feels super light on the skin but still keeps it moisturized. It absorbs quickly and doesn't feel sticky at all. After using it for a bit, my skin looks more fresh and hydrated, and it layers well under makeup too! gifted by tatcha
Gifted by tatcha. This has become one of my favorite moisturizer. My skin feels softer and more plump, and it stays hydrated all day.
